description: Synthetic inputs: 750 mL wine at 13.5% ABV, 150 mL serving, 297 kJ per 100 mL, kJ and Cal, package word bottle, 35 mm (the print-check width). 150 x 297 / 100 = 445.5 kJ, which rounds half up to 446. 297 kJ is below the 309 kJ per 100 mL that 13.5% alcohol alone provides, so the statement also carries the ENERGY_BELOW_ALCOHOL warning; the artwork is unaffected.
